description: This file defines the 'AcknowledgementRequest' interface in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.acks' package. It provides static factory methods for creating and parsing acknowledgement request instances, and declares methods to retrieve the label and string representation, serving as a core component for handling acknowledgement requests within the Ditto model.

classes.name: AcknowledgementRequest
classes.description: An immutable interface representing a domain-specific acknowledgement request, providing methods to obtain labels, parse acknowledgements, and generate string representations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new AcknowledgementRequest instance given a label.

methods.name: parseAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Parses a CharSequence into an AcknowledgementRequest instance.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label that identifies the acknowledgement request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation suitable for parsing back into an acknowledgement request.
